features.name: Retain the HK XM30 parent platform silhouette, grip/stock proportions and module interfaces; this is a parent-bound configuration, not a newly invented standalone model.
LMG configuration expressly requires bipod in core printed 308; nested printed 309/Arsenal176 table specifies belt feed.

Root inspected the prepared overlay against the single accepted raw pair. Paired silhouette and landmarks remain aligned; each source mask retains its own components/openings, with no discarded components or filled holes. Thin members and structural openings retained. Fine grooves/seams are nonblocking. Native1254 images retained;2048 is resampled, not native2K. Core308-309/PDF310-311 XM30 original platform set and configuration table. Bottom long family drawing has bipod and short hanging belt;no individually labeled own LMG drawing. Actual324 detail retains tapered composite family body,rigidstock,muzzleleft,central grip,REARbelt and twolegbipod,no scope or drum. Source form accepted;finish,minor housing contours and hidden depth artistic interpretation. Requires whole uncut assembly. Actual detailed/clay pair matches source family and LMG configuration:two bipod legs,short rear hanging belt,rigidstock,tapered upperbody,single grip/trigger opening,no imaging scope/drum. Thin supports and intentional openings intact. Exact fittings/unseen depth/color artistic. Native1254 originals retained,2048resampled. Shallow grooves harmless. Single final pair review reused at integration;no geometry/client/production approval.
